task: Root-Cause Audit: Recurring Foreign Flow Parse Errors
diagnosis: The TECH-1289 fix (validator integration, merged 2026-04-22 18:28) correctly addressed validation in the foreign_flow upsert path. However, a REGRESSION was introduced by an EARLIER commit (Sprint 1503b, merged 2026-04-20 02:57) that PERSISTS in the codebase. Lines 880-887 in src/interface/mcp/server.ts reconstruct WriteForeignFlowItem array from raw payload WITHOUT validation, using silent field coercion (foreignBuyVol ?? 0, foreignSellVol ?? 0). This unvalidated reconstruction feeds writeForeignFlowToOhlcv(), reintroducing the same silent filter bug at the OHLCV write stage.
root_cause: Unvalidated item reconstruction at lines 880-887 in src/interface/mcp/server.ts. After Step 5 correctly validates and upserts to foreign_flow table, Step 6 rebuilds WriteForeignFlowItem from rawItems (never validated) and passes to writeForeignFlowToOhlcv(). The reconstruction uses silent coercion: foreignBuyVol ?? 0, foreignSellVol ?? 0. If VPS sends invalid types (string, NaN, Infinity), the code coerces them to 0 without logging diagnostics, causing parse errors in the ohlcv write path.
why_1289_fix_failed: TECH-1289 fix correctly replaced silent filtering in foreignFlowFetcher.ts (lines 278-296) and added validation to the POST endpoint's upsertForeignFlow path (lines 798-824). However, it did NOT address the downstream writeForeignFlowToOhlcv path (lines 880-894) added in Sprint 1503b. The POST endpoint now has two sequential write operations: Step 5 (upsertForeignFlow) uses validated items correctly, but Step 6 (writeForeignFlowToOhlcv) reconstructs unvalidated items from raw payload. The 1289 fix stops at Step 5; parse errors now occur at Step 6, causing the recurring error spike.
permanent_solution: Remove redundant item reconstruction at lines 880-887. Instead of rebuilding WriteForeignFlowItem from rawItems, reuse the already-validated items (validItems or validationResult.valid from Step 3b). Map validItems directly to WriteForeignFlowItem schema without reconstruction. This ensures the same validated data is used for both upsertForeignFlow (Step 5) and writeForeignFlowToOhlcv (Step 6), eliminating silent coercion.

affected_lines.issue: Rebuilds WriteForeignFlowItem from rawItems (never validated) using silent coercion (?? 0 defaults)

recommended_fix.strategy: Reuse validated items instead of reconstructing from raw
recommended_fix.change_type: Replace silent reconstruction with direct mapping of validated items
recommended_fix.test_impact: No new tests needed; existing validation tests cover the regression
